newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via four-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via four-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York added temporary reserves to the banking system on Monday through four-day fixed system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.
The add move was in line with the market's expectations.
At 1130 EDT/1630 GMT, the time when the Fed usually intervenes in the market, federal funds were quoted at 5-5/16 percent, just above the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
